description: The Global Solar Power Tracker from Global Energy Monitor (GEM), a non-profit research organisation, gives facility-level data on utility-scale solar farms of 1 MW or more worldwide, plus country totals of distributed solar. On 26 September 2026 the page counted 103,940 solar farm phases, 2,093 GW (AC) of operating and 2,247 GW (AC) of prospective capacity, with distributed solar for 31 countries and areas. Records give location, capacity, status and owner by project phase, and summary tables give capacity by country, region, year and owner. The latest release was February 2026. Coverage is global. Access is through a free online tracker map, dashboards and summary tables, and the full data set is a spreadsheet downloadable through a short download form on GEM's site, under CC BY 4.0 at no cost. Caveats: distributed solar is only given as country totals, and for 31 countries and areas. Simulation uses are exposure of solar farms to hail, wind and flood, renewable build-out scenarios and grid connection planning. Related records: data-gem-global-integrated-power-tracker combines GEM's power trackers and data-gem-global-energy-ownership-tracker maps owners.
